headline: Leon Opens With A 124-Point Lead On Pure Optimism And Roughly Three Games Of Evidence
intro: Week one is in the books, teams have played two to four games, and the leaderboard is basically a list of who picked the teams that happened to win their first three. Mr Overs sits on 124.3 with Angus at 103.0, but don't go buying the engraved trophy yet, because win pace off three games is a fever dream and a single −10 will kill ya. Meanwhile Sam is propping up the spoon at −91.8, and the Knicks are 0-3 as reigning champs, which is great news for Nic and Dan's reputation and terrible news for Sammy's.

players.name: Leon
players.text: 124.3, and the Chinman is doing the victory lap already. Four overs at a perfect 3-0 or 2-0 (Pistons, Rockets, Blazers, Grizzlies) are printing money, with the Grizzlies alone worth +52.5, while the Nets 0-3 (−24.5) and Jazz (−10.2) are the only blemishes. Cade Cunningham's 26 kept the Pistons unbeaten, though Jalen Duren is out at least two weeks with a hamstring strain, a small worry for a pick sitting on +32.5. Efficiency has him at a still-healthy 80.7, so it's not all smoke.

players.name: Angus
players.text: 103.0 and Gooey's quietly sitting second off the back of two 0-3 teams: Warriors Under (+40.5) and Pelicans Under (+27.5). The Warriors are now missing Jimmy Butler for the long haul (back around January 2), Porzingis until at least December and Moody too, plus Curry and Horford popped up on this week's out list, so that Under looks very comfy. Lakers Over is humming after Luka dropped 52 on the Jazz, but the Suns Over is flat and Mark Williams is out for a long stint, so keep an eye on that one.

players.name: Nic
players.text: 69.0 and Visdog's fine, but he's the poster child for 'a few picks winning big while one picks lies to you'. Knicks Under (+52.5) is the star, with the champs 0-3 and Orlando just dropping them 111-102, Bucks Under and Kings Under are cooking too. The sting is Blazers Under at 2-0 and −39.5, and Shaedon Sharpe being out until March helps, but a 2-0 team is a 2-0 team. Thunder Over is humming at 3-0, though Jalen Williams going off with a significant injury, no diagnosis yet, is a flag worth watching.

players.name: Marco
players.text: 20.7, and Marci's the most 'meh' of the lot. Wolves Over is the highlight at +33.5, with Anthony Edwards scoring 26 in 27 minutes in a 117-94 romp, and the Hornets Over is doing alright on pace even if the efficiency says they're a bit lucky. Wizards Under (−20.2) is already looking shaky and Donte DiVincenzo's season-ending Achilles is a small blow to that Wolves Over. Still, plenty of scope to climb, or slide.

players.name: Roscoe the Dog
players.text: −10.0 on the scoreboard, but the efficiency has him at +41.9, which is the best of anyone not named Leon. Heat Under (+46.5) is a gift with Miami 0-3 and about to face Dallas, while Warriors Over (−40.5) and Pelicans Over (−27.5) are doing the damage. The dog fading the group is beating half the group, and if the Warriors injuries keep stacking he might have to eat his own words, which is somehow worse than the punishment.

players.name: Harry
players.text: −29.4 and a lot of picks sitting on the fence. Wizards Over is nicely up (+20.2) and Celtics Under is decent, but Wolves Under at 3-0 is a −33.5 anchor that DiVincenzo's absence will only partly relieve. Magic Over (−16.2) got a boost from beating the Knicks, but Banchero's out until around November 22, so that one's still got problems. Early days, mate.

players.name: Ned
players.text: −39.3, and Ned has the exact opposite problem to Leon: he took Under on three unbeaten teams. Pistons Under (−32.5), Rockets Under (−34.5) and Thunder Under (−19.5) are all underwater, which is a lot of pain for a bloke who's meant to be the clever one. Nets Under (+24.5) and Magic Under (+16.2) are keeping him afloat, but the efficiency of +0.9 says the damage might heal if those unbeaten teams come back to earth.

players.name: Dan
players.text: −56.2 for Doccy, and the Lakers Under at −35.5 is the poison, with Luka going for 52 and LA 3-0. Spurs Over (−32.2) at 1-2 isn't helping either. On the bright side, 76ers Over is up (+11.0) and LeBron's back from his back issue, worth about four wins to that pick, though Embiid was sat for plantar fasciitis management and Hukporti's gone for the season. The efficiency of −44.4 says it's not just bad luck.

players.name: Pos
players.text: −89.3, and Pos is one bad week away from taking the spoon. Grizzlies Under (−52.5) at 3-0 and Heat Over (−46.5) at 0-3 are a combined −99 of pain, and both picks would need the teams to flip completely. Spurs Under (+32.2) and Jazz Under (+10.2) are the only real positives. Efficiency has him at −74.2, so no hiding behind small samples here.

players.name: Sam
players.text: −91.8 and Sammy's holding the spoon, with the looming punishment of Roscoe's shit sitting right there on the horizon, just saying. Knicks Over (−52.5) at 0-3 and Bucks Over (−25.5) at 0-3 are the problem, and the −11.0 on 76ers Under isn't helped by LeBron coming back. The efficiency says +11.5, which means he's actually the unluckiest bloke in the comp, so there's hope, and Pacers Over has a small boost even with Johnny Furphy out for the season.

signoff: May your unders tank and your overs thrive!
